what_it_does: This study compares how well low-bit matrix-vector multiplication kernels (fused multiply-add operations using 8 bits or fewer) perform when written in SYCL (a portable programming standard) versus vendor-specific languages like CUDA and HIP. The researchers implement kernels, benchmark across multiple GPUs (datacenter A100/MI100, desktop RTX3090/MI250, laptop RTX4050/MI28), and analyze performance gaps through profiling to identify portability challenges.
